name: SikaBond FoamFix+

SIKABOND® FOAMFIX+: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: SikaBond® FoamFix+, September 2025, Version 02.03 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/c/sikabond_foamfix.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide SikaBond® FoamFix+ where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (September 2025, Version 02.03).
1.2 Product description. SikaBond® FoamFix+ is a 1-component, fast curing, polyurethane fixing foam with good adhesion to various substrates.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. SikaBond® FoamFix+ is designed for fixing plasterboards and insulation boards such as:
    - Extruded polystyrene boards (XPS)
    - Expanded polystyrene boards (EPS)
    - Wood fiber boards
    - Cork insulation boards
    - Bituminous felt faced PUR/PIR boards
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.6.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. SikaBond® FoamFix+
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: LOW EXPANSION POLYURETHANE FOAM ADHESIVE
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Certificates and test reports.
    - DIN 4102 class B2
    - KS M 3809 : 2021
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - DIN 4102: listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Certificates And Test Reports (p.1).
    - ISO 1926: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Tensile strength (p.1).
    - ISO 1922: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Shear strength (p.1).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - 1-Component
    - One pressure can lasts for an area of up to ~10 m²
    - Fast curing
    - Good adhesive tensile strength
    - Good adhesion to concrete, bituminous substrates, wood, brickwork, plaster, metal and PVC
    - Suitable for vertical and horizontal applications
    - Applicable for indoor and outdoor applications
    - HFC-free
2.5 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Composition: 1-Component polyurethane
    - Colour: Light yellow
    - Density: ~15 kg/m³
2.6 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Tensile strength: ~0.10 N/mm² (ISO 1926)
    - Shear strength: ~0.08 N/mm² (ISO 1922)
    - Dimensional stability: ~±10 %
    - Thermal conductivity: 0.036 W/mK (20±5) °C
    - Service temperature: −40 °C min. / +80 °C max.
2.7 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: 750 ml can with rubber valve, 12 cans per box
    - Storage conditions: SikaBond® FoamFix+ shall be stored in an upright position, in dry conditions, protected from direct sunlight and at temperatures between +5 °C and +25 °C.
2.8 Shelf life. SikaBond® FoamFix+ has a shelf life of 9 months from the date of production, if stored properly in undamaged, original, sealed packaging, and if the storage conditions are met. Opened cans of SikaBond® FoamFix+ must be used within 4 weeks.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 General. Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (September 2025, Version 02.03) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.
3.2 Substrate preparation. The substrate must be clean, sound and homogeneous, free from oils, grease, dust and loose or friable particles. Paint, cement laitance and other poorly adhering contaminants must be removed. SikaBond® FoamFix+ adheres without primers and/or activators. Pre-dampen the substrate with clean water, this ensures that the foam cures properly and also prevents secondary foam expansion.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (September 2025, Version 02.03) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Cutting time: ~12 min (after which a 20 mm bead of SikaBond® FoamFix+ can be cut). SikaBond® FoamFix+ is fully cured after 12 h.
    - Tack free time: ~7 min
4.3 Yield.
    | 750 ml can of SikaBond® FoamFix+ | ~10 m², styrofoam plate fixing |
    | ~30 m, straw cross-section 30 x 30 mm |
    | Consumption can be regulated by adjusting the pressure on the trigger. |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)
4.4 Instructions. For the application of SikaBond® FoamFix+ all generally accepted rules of building and construction apply.
4.5 Cleaning of equipment. Clean all tools and application equipment immediately with Sika Boom®-Cleaner and/or Sika® Remover-208. Once cured, residual material can only be removed mechanically.
4.6 Limitations and important considerations.
    - The minimum can temperature for application must be +10 °C.
    - In order to get a good quality foam, the can temperature should not vary more than 10 °C from the ambient temperature.
    - Protect the can from direct sunlight and temperatures above +50 °C (danger of explosion).
    - For correct curing of the foam, moisture is necessary.
    - Applying insufficient moisture may lead to subsequent unintended foam expansion (post expansion).
    - Do not use on polyethylene (PE), polypropylene (PP), polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE / Teflon), and silicone, oil, grease and other separating agents.
    - SikaBond® FoamFix+ is not resistant to UV light.
    - SikaBond® FoamFix+ is not designed to fill large voids but may fill small imperfections in the substrate.
    - Read all safety and technical recommendations which are printed on the SikaBond® FoamFix+ can.
4.7 Further documentation.
    - Safety Data Sheet

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Ambient air temperature.
    | Optimum | +18 °C min. / +25 °C max. |
    | Permissable | +5 °C min. / +30 °C max. |
5.3 Relative air humidity. 30 % min. / 95 % max.
5.4 Substrate temperature.
    | Optimum | +18 °C min. / +25 °C max. |
    | Permissable | +5 °C min. / +30 °C max. |
5.5 Conditions stated in the limitations. Also stated in the data sheet limitations (clause 4.6):
    - The minimum can temperature for application must be +10 °C.
    - In order to get a good quality foam, the can temperature should not vary more than 10 °C from the ambient temperature.
    - Protect the can from direct sunlight and temperatures above +50 °C (danger of explosion).
    - For correct curing of the foam, moisture is necessary.
    - Applying insufficient moisture may lead to subsequent unintended foam expansion (post expansion).
5.6 Test methods printed beside stated values. Each value is as printed in the data sheet with its test method.
    - Tensile strength: ~0.10 N/mm² (ISO 1926)
    - Shear strength: ~0.08 N/mm² (ISO 1922)
5.7 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.8 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: SikaBond® FoamFix+, September 2025, Version 02.03, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/c/sikabond_foamfix.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety-related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
